entities.summary: Old Church, a political institution in Bulgaria during First Bulgarian Empire (852–927). Grew from Founding & Bulgar-Slavic Fusion. Led to the emergence of Boris I adopts Christianity and Reign of Simeon the Great — Bulgarian Golden Age.
